What to know before choosing it

The RTX 5070 is a 12 GB GDDR7 base GPU specification. Pick the exact partner card before deciding whether it fits your case or matches your PSU cables.

Compare it with the RX 9070 and an exact RTX 5070 board. The useful questions are your game settings, required software features, delivered price and the physical card you can buy. Memory capacity alone cannot establish a performance winner.

Compare it with the RX 9070 and an exact RTX 5070 board. The useful questions are your game settings, required software features, delivered price and the physical card you can buy. Memory capacity alone cannot establish a performance winner.
